[LEARN]
insight: When fixing hardcoded paths, use a fallback chain: explicit config → environment variable → system PATH detection → graceful error with helpful message
context: This applies to any tool discovery (postgres, node, python, etc.) where users may have installations in non-standard locations

[PROMPT_UPDATE]
current: When implementing path detection, hardcode common defaults for convenience
suggested: Always support environment variable overrides for tool paths - developers often use package managers (homebrew, nix) that install in non-standard locations
reason: Reduces "works on my machine" bugs and improves portability across different development environments
